newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-COMPTON PLACE IN 50-1 NEWMARKET SHOCK.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-COMPTON PLACE IN 50-1 NEWMARKET SHOCK.

text.p: Compton Place, a 50-1 outsider, won the group one July Cup on Thursday to become the longest priced winner since the race was first run in 1876.
It was the first win at this level for trainer James Toller and jockey Seb Sanders whose horse enjoyed ground faster than when disappointing at Ascot last time out.

Compton Place won the six furlong (1.2 km) sprint by a length from 11-10 favourite Royal Applause, ridden by Michael Hills. Third place in the nine-strong field went to Indian Rocket, a 9-1 chance ridden by Richard Hills.
